name: agenttools
description: Reusable agent tools for interactive Codex token and context-window reports.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect Codex token usage by thread or date.
interface.longDescription: Agent Tools packages focused Codex workflows. Its first skill generates self-contained interactive reports for one thread or a local date range, with token totals, an inspectable token-progress dual-ring context view per session, a responsive session drawer, and unified subagent details.
defaultPrompt: Use $visualize-codex-tokens to inspect today's Codex token usage.
